description: Four attack, sustain and release envelopes, each with a VCA of its own, a set of global controls driving all of them at once, and a mixed output carrying the envelopes switched into it

params.text: Sets the attack time for all of the envelopes together, 0 to 1
Sets the release time for all of the envelopes together, 0 to 1
Starts all of the envelopes by hand
Scales the output of all of the envelopes, -2 to +2, default 1, with negative values turning them upside down
Switches all of the envelopes between straight line stages and exponential ones
Sets the attack time of that envelope, 0 to 1
Sets the release time of that envelope, 0 to 1
Switches that envelope between straight line stages and exponential ones
Scales that envelope's output, -2 to +2, default 1, with negative values turning it upside down
With it on that envelope releases as soon as its attack finishes, so a trigger is enough to run the whole shape; with it off a gate held up holds the sustain
With it on a new trigger restarts that envelope only once it has finished running
With it on a new trigger starts that envelope from zero rather than from the level it had reached
With it on, and with AR MODE on as well, that envelope retriggers itself at the end of each cycle
With it on that envelope is summed into the mixed envelope output in the GLOBAL column

inputs.text: A voltage added to the attack time of all of the envelopes, the voltage divided by 5
A voltage added to the release time of all of the envelopes, the voltage divided by 5
A trigger or a gate starts all of the envelopes
The signal into the VCA driven by the mixed envelope
A voltage added to that envelope's attack time, the voltage divided by 5
A voltage added to that envelope's release time, the voltage divided by 5
A trigger or a gate starts that envelope
The signal into that envelope's VCA

outputs.text: The sum of every envelope whose UNITY MIX is switched on
The signal out of the VCA driven by the mixed envelope
That envelope's voltage; a small lamp follows the same value
A pulse when that envelope's attack finishes
A pulse when that envelope's release finishes
The signal out of that envelope's VCA, the input scaled by the envelope

menu: Channel one is poly — turns the first channel's ports into four channel polyphonic ports, so the module works as one polyphonic attack, sustain and release envelope with its VCA
